summary: Ing-Simmons et al. 2021 (Nat Genet), 10x scRNA-seq of whole embryos at 2.5-3.5 h after egg laying (ArrayExpress E-MTAB-9304); replaces the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006191 with fresh VFBseq ids. Controls only (the gd7 / Toll rm9/rm10 / Toll10B embryos of mutant mothers, fate-transformed, left out): 2 Samples / 2 Assays (embryonic stage; embryo; replicate 1 linked to PCNA[EGFP] by GENO has_genotype). One Clustering with the authors' 15 clusters (all genotypes integrated) restricted to their 7,739 control cells, from SCEA's per-cell author labels: 13 loaded (embryonic germ-layer and structure cell terms; the cellularisation clusters also at embryonic stage 5), 2 neural clusters held. Summary expression as CPM from SCEA's quantification (16,786 genes x 7,739 cells).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.

Controls only: the two wild-type replicates. The embryos of gd7, Toll rm9/rm10 and Toll10B mothers are fate-transformed (a single dorsoventral fate), so their cells are left out; the authors' 15 clusters (made with all genotypes integrated) are loaded, restricted to their control cells.

Samples at embryonic stage (FBdv:00005289): 2.5-3.5 h at 25 C spans stage 5 and the gastrula stage (6-8), the paper's 'cellular blastoderm and gastrulation stages'; the SDRF's 'stage 5 embryo' is too narrow. Tissue embryo; sex mixed (unset).

Genotype: replicate 1 ('yw; eGFP-PCNA' from Blythe & Wieschaus 2016; SDRF 'w[*]; P{EGFP-PCNA}attP2') is FlyBase PCNA[EGFP] (FBal0366828), with no FlyBase stock or insertion, so linked by genotype_includes; replicate 2 is w1118 (wild type). FlyBase curated no genetic entities for this paper.
Samples by build_samples_from_arrayexpress.py with sdrf_include (the two control sources): one Sample per SDRF source, one Assay per 10x library (the SDRF rows are lanes).

Clusters by build_clusters.py from SCEA's per-cell 'inferred cell type - authors labels' (16,786 cells; the paper 16,790): one per author cluster, the control cells only; typed by the cell identity without the cluster number. ArrayExpress has FASTQs only and the authors' code saves no labels.

Ectoderm / mesoderm to the germ-layer cell terms (somatic cell of ectoderm / mesoderm: the authors' words; most embryos in the window are gastrulating), not the anlage terms of the old load; cellularisation to somatic cell of stage 5 embryo with Cluster stage embryonic stage 5 (from the clusters' own expression, bnk / slam, the authors' reading); pole cells to embryonic pole cell; amnioserosa, terminal, haemocytes, trachea precursor to their embryonic cell terms.
neural1 / neural2 held (no term): FBbt has no cell-level generic embryonic neural cell term, and embryonic neuroblast would go beyond the authors' typing (neural2's markers are neuronal).

Expression from SCEA's quantification of E-MTAB-9304 (alevin aggregated filtered counts; the only count matrix; cell ids match the author labels), as CPM; FBgn ids mapped to current FlyBase genes (16,711 current, 76 secondary, 1 merge; 148 withdrawn and 1 split dropped).
All 15 mapping.tsv rows reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).

checks.check: SCEA per-cell author labels against the paper.
checks.result: 16,786 labelled cells in the 15 author clusters (the paper: 16,790); every cluster has control cells (7,739 in all).

checks.check: Cluster names against the authors' code (scRNA-seq_figures_PCNA-GFP.Rmd cluster_assignments) and Supplementary Table 2 markers.
checks.result: Names and cluster numbers agree; top markers fit (e.g. twi / Mdr49 mesoderm2, Ance / peb amnioserosa, pgc / nos pole cells, bnk / slam cellularisation).

checks.check: verify_mappings.py: every FBbt term in the mappings looked up in OLS (FBbt 2026-10-01).
checks.result: 8 terms current, not obsolete, labels match.

checks.check: FBbt, FBdv and FBcv terms on the Samples, Assays, Clusters and Dataset looked up in OLS.
checks.result: All current (embryonic stage, embryonic stage 5, embryo, single-cell RNA-Seq, 10x sequencing).

checks.check: Marker spot checks in the expression output.
checks.result: twi 0.92 in mesoderm2, Ance 0.94 in amnioserosa, pgc / nanos 0.95 in pole cells, fkh in terminal, slam in cellularisation2, Osi7 in trachea precursor, Apoltp / Tep4 in haemocytes2; PPO1 (~0.03) and Mlc2 (0.13) weak in this quantification.
